title: Lumen Business Analyst onboarding
supportedQuestion: Which fields belong in the Lumen requirement template, and how should acceptance criteria be written?
supportedFact: Requirement fields: Problem / User / Outcome / Scope / Open questions. Acceptance criteria use Given / When / Then.
missingQuestion: What is the approved delivery budget for LUM-101?

tasks.title: Read requirements guide
tasks.instructions: Read the fictional Lumen guide and summarize LUM-101's outcome and scope in an unsent practice note.
tasks.suggestedQuestion: What outcome and scope does the fictional LUM-101 welcome-checklist brief describe?

tasks.title: Review the glossary
tasks.instructions: Review Learner, Checklist task, Published guide and Job role before using those terms in the exercise.
tasks.suggestedQuestion: How does the fictional Lumen guide define Learner, Checklist task and Published guide?

tasks.title: Inspect the sample requirement
tasks.instructions: Review LUM-101 using Problem, User, Outcome, Scope and Open questions. Separate the discovery Observation, Assumption and Question in your practice notes.
tasks.suggestedQuestion: Which fields belong in the Lumen requirement template, and how should discovery observations, assumptions and questions be separated?

tasks.title: Write a learner user story
tasks.instructions: Draft an unsent story using As a <role>, I want <action>, so that <outcome>, grounded in the guide-reading example for LUM-101.
tasks.suggestedQuestion: What user-story format and guide-reading example does the fictional Lumen guide provide?

tasks.title: Add acceptance criteria
tasks.instructions: Write observable Given / When / Then criteria for guide reading and self-reported task completion, using AC-01 and AC-02 as examples.
tasks.suggestedQuestion: How should LUM-101 acceptance criteria use Given / When / Then, and what do AC-01 and AC-02 demonstrate?

tasks.title: Map the sample learner flow
tasks.instructions: Map choose role, read task, inspect published guide and mark task complete. Show the learner decision that may leave a task incomplete.
tasks.suggestedQuestion: What is the fictional Lumen sample learner flow, and where does the learner decide whether to complete a task?

tasks.title: Review requirement traceability
tasks.instructions: Trace LUM-101 to the learner story, AC-01 or AC-02 and an observable guide-reading or completion check. Flag missing links as open questions.
tasks.suggestedQuestion: How should each LUM-101 acceptance criterion connect to a scenario ID and an observable check?

tasks.title: Prepare a small refinement note
tasks.instructions: Prepare an unsent Decision / Rationale / Remaining question note about separating guide reading from task completion; include the relevant LUM-101 and criterion reference.
tasks.suggestedQuestion: What fields and example decision belong in the fictional Lumen refinement note?
